$comment: Known, intentional conflicts between PDF samples (v1.10.1) and the OpenAPI schemas. The checker requires each listed fixture/environment to fail with exactly these errors (path = JSON pointer into the sample, keyword = failing JSON Schema keyword, unknownProperty = field the schema does not declare, json-syntax = sample is not valid JSON). A listed item that starts passing fails the check, so remove entries when the spec or this list is fixed. Do not edit samples or loosen schemas to clear an entry.

expectedFailures.reason: p20 states isDentalService is a string "0"/"1", but the p21 sample sends the number 1. The spec follows the prose (string enum 0/1); the sample is kept verbatim.
The p26 sample carries clientId, but p15 declares clientId a pilot-only field, so the production request schema does not declare it. The pilot run passes.
The p30 sample sends prescTypeId as the string "01", while the p15 table types it Integer (1) and the enum is integer. The spec follows the table; the sample is kept verbatim.
The p38-39 sample is not valid JSON: trailing comma after srvCode "00000D1352" and the closing brace of the object is missing. A syntax-only repaired copy is validated separately.
The p49-50 sample is not valid JSON: comma missing after "lstatus": "0" and trailing comma after referralDate. A syntax-only repaired copy is validated separately.
